name: Kenya
summary: 16 years leading critical-care laboratory operations at one of Africa's leading research programmes.
achievements: Section Head, STAT Laboratory — KEMRI-Wellcome Trust Research Programme, Kilifi (16-year tenure)
Laboratory operations lead for the Phase III RTS,S/AS01 malaria vaccine trial

Supported landmark neonatal and pediatric trials — including FEAST, KIPMAT, and the Severe Malaria Fluid study — that directly informed WHO management guidelines for reducing infant and neonatal mortality
Managed a biobank of over 2,000,000 sample aliquots across international shipments with near-zero error
Redesigned laboratory data capture systems, achieving 100% data accuracy
Co-authored a peer-reviewed study on iron deficiency and acute seizures in Kenyan children (PLoS ONE, 2010)
KMLTTB Registered laboratory professional (Kenya's national regulatory board)

name: Sierra Leone
summary: Operational leadership across a national Ebola vaccine research programme, plus maternal and child health diagnostics.
achievements: Operational and technical lead across the Parasitology, Safety, Molecular, and Biorepository sections of LSHTM's multi-site Ebola vaccine research program (Phase I–IV)
Contributed to research published in The Lancet Infectious Diseases — adult and pediatric Ebola vaccine safety and immunogenicity studies (2022), and a 2023 booster-dose study
Supported the PREVAC Ebola vaccine trial programme (published in the New England Journal of Medicine), part of a multi-country West African research collaboration

Partnered with the Ministry of Health, through Mobilab Medical Innovations, on maternal and child health diagnostics — anemia screening in pregnant mothers and sickle cell disease screening in infants and children
Supported the design and setup of national clinical trial laboratory capacity, including biorepository architecture and cold-chain planning

name: Tanzania
summary: Multi-site ISO 15189 accreditation strengthening across a national laboratory network.
achievements: Advised clinical and research laboratories on ISO 15189 implementation through regional quality management consulting (Mobilab / RAMS Global)
Trained laboratory staff on documentation, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, and quality management fundamentals
Supported multiple laboratories toward ASLM (African Society for Laboratory Medicine) accreditation milestones

name: Rwanda
summary: Regional technical assistance and laboratory systems strengthening.
achievements: Provided technical assistance supporting laboratory systems strengthening as part of regional public health partnership work
